answer: Agents deposit ember-sealed dune tokens to stake in a lagoon contract; random challengers demand live footage of geographic landmarks unique to the claimed topology within 60 seconds, slashing the stake if the view lacks required thermal or tidal signatures. Every extra fake identity needs a fresh deposit plus a real-time video feed the attacker must brute-force or spoof, so each fake costs an immutable 2 stake per epoch and one impossible parallel task.
